prespecified_plan.workload: 3 variants: initial-zero; unchanged-noninitial; rewritten-noninitial. 7 repetitions, both modes, 256 restore/modify/save pairs. Alternate first mode by repetition. All 42 samples per boot retained; no sample retry or deletion.
prespecified_plan.qualification: Exact local CPU0 handle/placement; CPUID.D1 XSAVEOPT/TSC/OSXSAVE and actual XCR0=7; standard active bounds/canaries/all16YMM/full8x87/TOP/control/rounding oracles. Real IRQ/VM effects retained and annotated.
prespecified_plan.regression_rule: For each variant and each separate classic/auto boot, calculate the 7 paired differences opt-classic in cycles/pair. A measured regression requires at least 6 positive pairs and median paired difference greater than max(5 percent of median classic cycles/pair, 2 times MAD of paired differences). Confirmed same variant in both boots => use classic as final default. A signal in only one boot is uncertainty and also conservatively keeps classic; no additional selected performance rerun. Otherwise permit opt; do not claim isolated scheduler or hardware skipped-byte gain.
prespecified_plan.limits: This comparison covers guest-TSC restore/optional rewrite/save/loop including VM pauses and IRQ costs. STANDARD is one final independent unchanged all4 run, never a mode-selection rerun. Native hardware and precise scheduler-cycle impact remain unqualified. Optional policy retains explicit classic fallback.

standard.limits: Exactly one final normal unchanged Suite3/all4, full original readback. Actual SIMD compiler/event checks are independent of STANDARD. All14 measured Spectra sources/references unchanged. Previous47 original retained. Only real local KVM4/software/RAM; no native hardware/Windows or isolated performance gain inferred.

implementation: BSP and each successfully FPU-admitted AP report actual local CPUID.D1:EAX0. A single compare-exchange seals classic or XSAVEOPT before the first AP RELEASE_EPOCH write. Every configured slot must be known and support the optional instruction and the existing standard XSAVE contract must remain valid; unknown/missing/unsupported/config-disabled uses classic. No optional requirement is added to module ISA. Already sealed OPT requires fresh local support on AP restart before common image admission.

Only private typed native task saves may use XSAVEOPT. Exact CPU-local last restored native id, generation and image pointer must match; new/reused/migrated/unknown images fall back conservatively. Validated canonical initial images/header/capacity remain unchanged. Generic save/restore, canonical IRQ/initial images and private waiting-fault buffers stay classic; generic/initial restore clears local task identity. Kernel-owned perCPU counters count executed instructions, not omitted bytes, without new locked RMW in each save; readout acquires existing runtime admission and copies only counters.

Architectural hardware XRSTOR_INFO separately compares actual restore address/CPL/VMX/XCOMP_BV for modified optimization. Userland own XRSTOR is not observable by the software tag, so that architectural check remains essential. Images stay initialized standard layout/XCOMP_BV0, mask7 and active832; absent/initial component bytes are never treated as newly zeroed bytes. No XSAVEC/XSAVES/AVX512/AMX, enlarged task image, public OPT API or new Contract table.

Private boot selftest xsaveopt reuses complete xstate-contract bounds/nine rejections/canary/normal live snapshot plus full existing register/rounding/reserve/work/IRQ/migration/controlled-return oracles. Separate real KVM4 classic policy0 and auto policy1 boots use the same source and Spectra inputs, real joins and natural poweroff; actual optimized task-save execution must be zero for classic and positive for OPT. Same valid early FXSAVE512/XSAVE-mask3-57648cases each pass on final source and normal default ELF/semantic config restore exactly.

Spectra CHECK SIMD /SAVECOST owns a private bounded CPU0 worker and aligned initialized standard state. Actual local CPUID/XCR0 gating precedes all optional instructions. Complete integer/pointer SysV assembly has no call, saves caller controls, measures 256 restore/optional rewrite/save pairs using serialized guest TSC and restores controls. Three variants, seven predetermined repetitions and both modes alternate order; all42rawsamples per boot retained. Independent full16YMM/8x87/TOP/control/rounding and header/tail oracle, exact task/generation/own RIP event metadata and actual join qualify results. IRQs/VM pauses are not filtered out. This is neither isolated save latency nor whole scheduler gain.

A first auto guest is deliberately retained as unqualified: register worker B returned85 at immediate placement metadata check, before opening any register window. The API accepts a pending request and applies it after saved-context handoff. Spectra now waits at most64sleep safe points for the same own handle/revision, CPU0/home0 and no pending flag before all affected windows. Register/rounding/oracle code is unchanged. Both final functional fixtures exclude SAVECOST: all84 original cost samples independently passed their own command/full oracle before the unrelated later admission failure; exact source comparison proves only the admission prefix changed before CPUID, and measurement assembly remains byte-exact source. No cost sample is retried, replaced or selected; original failed guest source/container/ELF/serial/media remain retained.

Fault-native identity publication now has explicit compiler fences around odd-sequence publication and identity reads; no new hardware MFENCE. Existing terminal capture/NoFPU-idle/public ABI remain unchanged. Pure qualification/tag tests3, Kernel fmt/Clippy/build,29Spectra tests, actual optimized IR/ELF and all prior numerical/indirect-control oracles pass. Only Kernel371/Spectra48 artifacts change; Contract41/SDK58/Libraries23/29other products/14fonts/oldfixtures/14STANDARDinputs exact. Exactly one final normal unchanged Suite3/all4 and complete original DevCenter readback.
